display_information.name: Hunch
display_information.description: Ask your team thoughtful, anonymous questions. See what people actually believe.
display_information.long_description: Hunch is a forecasting tool for your team. Ask a question (a launch date, a hire, a target), let people commit play-money hunches to YES or NO, and see the aggregated signal as a leader. Participants never see the crowd's probability — that prevents anchoring and information cascades. Anonymity is absolute: no one ever sees who bet what.

slash_commands.description: Ask, weigh in, resolve. Run `/hunch help` for subcommands.
slash_commands.usage_hint: create | me | resolve | admin | leaderboard | reset
